title: egress queue counters are broken in voq systems
author: skbarista
body:
#### Description

Egress queue counters are broken in voq systems,

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Enable queue counter polling
2. Do show queue counters

#### Describe the results you received:

None of the queue counters were retrieved.

#### Describe the results you expected:

Expecting queue counters to be displayed.

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
[counterpoll.txt](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/files/10875978/counterpoll.txt)
[queuecounters.txt](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/files/10875979/queuecounters.txt)

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix egress queue counters in voq systems.
linkedPullRequests.author: skbarista
linkedPullRequests.body:
**What I did**
swss: Fix egress queue counters in voq systems.
 * In voq systems, the buffer profiles are defined on sysports.So the phy ports do not have buffer queue config and queuesStateVector built by getQueueConfigurations in flexcounterorch never has phy ports in voq systems. So in voq systems, always enable egress queue counters.
 
**Why I did it**

Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/14061

**How I verified it**

Verified egress queue counters and voq counters on both 7800r3ak_36dm2_lc and 7800r3_48cqm2_lc

**Details if related**
